name: codex-dsh-web
description: Drive and verify DSH Web sessions from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to local DSH Web sessions.
interface.longDescription: Delegate tasks to local DSH Web sessions with automatic permissions, optional live Browser visibility, and independent Codex verification.
defaultPrompt: Open DSH Web in Codex's built-in browser and confirm the local service is reachable.
Use DSH Web to implement this task, show the active session, then verify the changes.
Use DSH Web to review this repository without modifying files.
